jei.thaumaturgicbases.info.advanced_alch: Thaumaturge's essentia smelter, faster, and faster again while it burns alumentum.
jei.thaumaturgicbases.info.aurelia_petal: Under a full moon, with a clear view of the sky, an Aurelia opens and now and then sheds petals onto the ground nearby; break the fallen petals to collect them.
jei.thaumaturgicbases.info.bloody_cloth: Wipe a bloody spike with enchanted fabric: the spike is clean and you keep the bloody cloth. The crucible washes it back into fabric.
jei.thaumaturgicbases.info.brazier: Burns on Ignis essentia from nearby jars (6 Ignis for 80 seconds) and wards off monsters like the campfire.
jei.thaumaturgicbases.info.briar_seedbag: Harvested from a grown Briar bush.
jei.thaumaturgicbases.info.campfire: Right-click it with a log (greatwood and silverwood burn four times as long), then feed it furnace fuel. Monsters within 12 blocks back away from it.
jei.thaumaturgicbases.info.ender_leaves: Part of an Ender tree grown from its sapling.
jei.thaumaturgicbases.info.ender_log: Cut from an Ender tree grown from its sapling.
jei.thaumaturgicbases.info.entity_decons: Hurts whatever stands on it and teaches the player who last clicked it. Feed it primal crystal blocks (after its advanced research) to make it faster and let it break down dropped items too.
jei.thaumaturgicbases.info.golden_oak_le: Part of a Golden Oak grown from its sapling.
jei.thaumaturgicbases.info.herobrines_sc: As in Thaumic Bases, it cannot be crafted: the research only tells of it.
jei.thaumaturgicbases.info.inverse_reloc: Pulls entities in along its facing, 10 blocks per relocator stacked behind it. Sneak to flip it; a redstone signal switches it off.
jei.thaumaturgicbases.info.knose_fragmen: Harvested from a fully grown Knose.
jei.thaumaturgicbases.info.nether_leaves: Part of a Nether tree grown from its sapling.
jei.thaumaturgicbases.info.nether_log: Cut from a Nether tree grown from its sapling.
jei.thaumaturgicbases.info.overchanter: Place an enchanted item on it, then use a caster on it to raise one enchantment beyond its normal limit.
jei.thaumaturgicbases.info.peaceful_leav: Part of a Peaceful tree grown from its sapling.
jei.thaumaturgicbases.info.peaceful_log: Cut from a Peaceful tree grown from its sapling.
jei.thaumaturgicbases.info.relocator: Pushes entities along its facing, 10 blocks per relocator stacked behind it. Sneak to flip it; a redstone signal switches it off.
jei.thaumaturgicbases.info.tobacco_leave: Harvested from a fully grown tobacco plant.
research.thaumaturgicbases.advanced_alch: The essentia smelter is slow. More bellows help a little, but bellows right beside the flame would melt it into slag. Lined with thaumium, the furnace takes the heat: it works like a basic smelter, but twice as fast while it burns alumentum. Bellows still speed it up further.
research.thaumaturgicbases.advanced_entr: Crucible grinding. Alchemy offers much more than you can think of!

Previously you could only use Perditio to break the simplest items. Now you have found a way to grind more of them in the crucible: wool falls apart into string, sandstone into sand and a blaze rod into three piles of powder. There must be a way to make the process more efficient, but that needs more research.
research.thaumaturgicbases.alchemy_resto: Some blocks take a better shape when dropped into the crucible with a little Ordo: gravel goes back to cobblestone and stone bricks gain their carving. Not that a thaumaturge ever needs cobblestone. Oddly, the same works on ice, but there Ordo does nothing: Terra and Gelum pack it instead.
research.thaumaturgicbases.amber.stage_1: Enough Vinculum together with a spruce sapling in the crucible turns the sapling's resin into amber. Other trees seem too mundane for it.
research.thaumaturgicbases.amber.title: Making Amber
research.thaumaturgicbases.ashroom.stage: Vishrooms turn out to be stores of aspects that have lost the ability to release them. A simple crucible treatment restores it. Grow a Primal Shroom on any solid block and break it when fully grown: it bursts into a rain of primal aspect orbs.
research.thaumaturgicbases.ashroom.title: Primal Shrooms
research.thaumaturgicbases.aurelia.stage: Auram is a hard aspect to come by without draining auras or hunting wisps. The Aurelia offers another way. Under a full moon at night, with a clear view of the sky, this flower opens its petals to feed on the moonlight, and while open it now and then sheds petals onto the ground nearby. The petals are rich in Auram.
research.thaumaturgicbases.aurelia.title: Aurelia
research.thaumaturgicbases.backprocessin: Reverting stuff. Many things, once broken down, cannot be restored by normal means... but you are a thaumaturge.

Sugar and green dye return to sugar cane and cactus with a little Ordo and Victus. Less mundane materials take more: blaze powder becomes a whole rod again with Ordo, Ignis, Praecantatio, Potentia and plenty of Fabrico and Permutatio, and bone meal can be pressed back into a bone.
Thaumaturgy reaches into alchemy, infusion and enchanting, yet most thaumaturges ignore plant life. You do not. Your first thaumic plant is the Sweed: grass with a touch of Motus and Victus. It is technically a weed, but once fully grown it can be harvested for sugar and reeds. Watch it, though: ripe Sweed spreads quickly onto nearby soil.
Robes sewn from bloody cloth are light and help with casting: 4%, 3% and 2% less vis for the robe, leggings and boots. The blood in them lends strength, too: the robe adds a fifth to your health, the leggings half again your footing against knockback, the boots a tenth more speed.
research.thaumaturgicbases.bracelet_blaz: You have created a bracelet that shares the same functionality as the blaze wand core - it will slowly regenerate ignis vis inside it.
research.thaumaturgicbases.bracelet_bone: You have created a bracelet that shares the same functionality as the bone wand core - it will slowly regenerate perditio vis inside it.
research.thaumaturgicbases.bracelet_gold: Since iron is much more mundane than gold you might want to use that instead. The golden bracelet simply holds more vis than the iron one and also gives more vis discount.
research.thaumaturgicbases.bracelet_grea: Similar to how wands can be made out of greatwood bracelets can too. It simply holds more vis than the golden one, yet keeping the same vis discount.
You have created a bracelet that shares the same functionality as the ice wand core - it will slowly regenerate aqua vis inside it.
research.thaumaturgicbases.bracelet_iron: Since the discovery of wands you have been thinking of alternating the way vis channels through the wand. The wand on it's own has a very basic system of vis channelling - it uses the Vis from the core and exports it into the world using the caps. Well, that makes the wand a universal device it can use vis offensively, defensively and for crafts. But it both lacks the power for offensive usage and the efficiency for crafts. Sure there are staffs and sceptres. The sceptres are fine, but you think that the staffs can be made... differently. By completely removing the core from the construction, adding some mundane parts to hold it all together and making a 'zone of potency' with the caps you have discovered the Bracelets. They are your alternative to the staffs. Due to their construction they do not come in thousands of variants - there are some though. You are also sure, that you can't combine different caps to create a bracelet - it will be unstable and will not work. Only the regular caps discovered by thaumaturges can be used to create the bracelets too... The bracelet works just as your regular wand would - it can drain vis from nodes, it can be charged in a wand recharging pedestal, it can harvest the aspect orbs from mobs. The bracelets also work with foci - it is what they were made for. However since the bracelet has no core it is very limited in the amount of vis it can store - the most basic one - the iron can only store 10! Due to the bracelets having no core, they can't be used for crafting. However what they shine at is the usage of foci. First of all they have an amazing vis discount for doing so. Any foci in the bracelet will have it's cooldown greatly reduced. The foci are also MUCH faster and potent than in wands. Lastly since the bracelets are extremely small they also will get affected by the invisibility potion if their carrier is. Bracelets hold a focus like any caster, pay a third less vis than their caps would on a wand, and cool down in half the time.
research.thaumaturgicbases.bracelet_obsi: From the depths of the world
You have created a bracelet that shares the same functionality as the obsidian wand core - it will slowly regenerate terra vis inside it.
research.thaumaturgicbases.bracelet_prim: Using your knowledge of the Staff core of the Primal you have created a bracelet that shares the same functionality. It will slowly regenerate all aspects within itself up to 10%. It also holds the most vis out of all bracelets and offers the best discount. Lastly, similar to the primal staff core it will automatically add 1 level of Potency to any foci used with it.
research.thaumaturgicbases.bracelet_quar: You have created a bracelet that shares the same functionality as the quartz wand core - it will slowly regenerate ordo vis inside it.
research.thaumaturgicbases.bracelet_reed: You have created a bracelet that shares the same functionality as the reed wand core - it will slowly regenerate aer vis inside it.
research.thaumaturgicbases.bracelet_silv: The greatwood bracelet is great, but there always is a room for improvement. Using silverwood instead of greatwood allows the creation of a better bracelet. It also has a pretty good vis discount
research.thaumaturgicbases.bracelet_thau: Since you have discovered a way to make wands out on thaumium you have applied the same to the bracelets. This one holds more vis than the greatwood one and has a better vis discount too
research.thaumaturgicbases.bracelet_void: You have applied your discovery of the void wand creation to the bracelet. This new bracelet shares the same functionality - it will slowly regenerate aspects and has a pretty good vis discount.
research.thaumaturgicbases.brazier.stage: The campfire needs logs and fuel by hand. The Brazier of Warding keeps itself burning on Ignis essentia instead: 6 Ignis from nearby jars keeps it lit for 80 seconds, and it wards off monsters just as the campfire does.
research.thaumaturgicbases.brazier.title: Brazier of Warding
research.thaumaturgicbases.briar.stage_1: Plants are known for their medicinal uses. Taking a rose bush back to its wild state gives the Briar, a two-block bush that grows quickly. Once ripe its seed bags can be picked by right-clicking. With sugar and an empty phial at the arcane workbench they make Rosehip Syrup, a better milk: it stacks to 16, clears blindness, nausea, mining fatigue, hunger, slowness, poison, weakness and wither, and weakens several of the thaumaturge's own afflictions by one level.
research.thaumaturgicbases.briar.title: Briar
research.thaumaturgicbases.campfire.stag: A safe night in the woods.

Caught in the woods at nightfall, far from your bed? Build a campfire. Right-click it with a log (a greatwood or silverwood log burns four times as long), then feed it any furnace fuel. The fire is imbued with magic, and monsters within 12 blocks back away from it, as creepers flee cats. Hungry enough, they may still come close: it is no absolute protection.
research.thaumaturgicbases.cap_thauminit: No infusion here! Thauminite works just as thaumium does, so why not make wand caps from it?

Thauminite caps come out inert, and infusion cannot wake them. Working more Salis Mundus into them at the arcane workbench solves this, at the price of more primal crystals. The caps are slightly more efficient than thaumium ones. Fit them to any rod in the arcane workbench as usual.
research.thaumaturgicbases.crying_obsidi: Beds are unreliable: they can be blown up, you can only sleep at night, monsters keep you awake, and someone else may be in yours. Infusing the nature of a bed into obsidian makes Crying Obsidian. Stack exactly two to form an obelisk and right-click it: you will respawn beside the last obelisk you clicked, as long as it stands whole. Sleeping in a bed moves your spawn back to the bed.
research.thaumaturgicbases.crystal_block: Ordo taught you how blocks take shape in the crucible, so you tried something bigger. A crystal cluster dropped in with every primal, extra essentia of its own aspect and some Fabrico collapses into a solid, glowing block that keeps the cluster's properties. A vitium cluster gives a Tainted Crystal Block, and one block of each primal pressed together gives six Balanced ones. Three blocks make six slabs.
research.thaumaturgicbases.deco_blocks.s: For a long time thaumaturges could only use amber blocks as decoration. Quicksilver, it turns out, can be packed into a solid block just like any metal, and four such blocks pressed together make handsome silvery bricks. An order crystal set in obsidian and gold makes the dark Eldritch Ark, and the same crystal binds greatwood planks with iron into a sturdy decorative wood.
research.thaumaturgicbases.elder_knowled: A blade that learns: its kills sometimes teach you the aspects of what they slew, more often at higher levels. It cannot be combined with the other thaumic enchantments. It also appears on the enchanting table.
research.thaumaturgicbases.eldritch_bane: Smite for the creatures of the Outer Lands: +5 damage a level against endermen and eldritch beings. Like Sharpness, it does not combine with the other damage enchantments.
research.thaumaturgicbases.ender_sapling: An ender-infused tree that slowly turns the mundane ground beneath it into end stone and obsidian. Endermen are drawn to its canopy and other ender creatures may appear, but never a dragon. Its planks are remarkably blast resistant, and the dragon cannot break its wood.
research.thaumaturgicbases.entity_decons: Exploring the world and the deconstruction table are not the only ways to learn. This plate breaks living things down into their aspects and sends the knowledge straight into your mind: every two seconds whatever stands on it takes a little magic damage, and you gain an observation in the field its aspects belong to. Click the plate to link it to yourself. The knowledge fades with distance and only reaches you within 32 blocks. Standing on it yourself is a bad idea.

The basic deconstructor is limited, but crystal blocks of the primal aspects can be socketed into its frame by right-clicking it with them. Each one extends the reach of the knowledge by 8 blocks and makes the plate work faster. With all six primals installed it also breaks down dropped items lying on it: they do not always teach you something, but they do so more often than the deconstruction table.
research.thaumaturgicbases.fluxium.stage: You had no intention of making this. Fluxium is a flower that gathers flux from the air around it and, having gathered enough, vents it above itself into the aura. You are not sure what it is good for, but its knack for drawing aspects from its surroundings could be the base for something bigger.
research.thaumaturgicbases.fluxium.title: Fluxium
research.thaumaturgicbases.focus_activat: Well, after your research on the ability of mirrors of transporting items it would be logical to continue onwards - what if mirrors could transport simple force and image? Well, it is not that simple, so you had to make a wand foci out of all that mess you were getting yourself into. This wand foci works really simple - once equipped on the wand a thaumaturge must shift-click on the desired block's location, which will store it to the wand. After that a simple click will act like a right click on the stored location. However, the range is limited to 32 blocks. Some mundane inventories are also too heavy for the transmitted force to interact with, should they bee far from a thaumaturge. Potency Upgrade Available at all levels, this upgrade will increase the range of interaction up by 10 blocks. Will not work in unloaded chunks!
research.thaumaturgicbases.focus_drain.s: Sometimes a Thaumaturge wants to live under the sea, next to his pineapple in his beautifull water dome. However, building underwater is a huge pain... Until now. This wand foci will resolve the problem! It will destroy blocks of water the thaumaturge is looking at, without making all nearby water blocks flow! In other ways, it is perfect in creating tunnels! However, magic can only harness the water so long, and the water will eventually return to it's normal flowing state. It will also do so should a block be placed next to the not-flowing water block. Aquatic Upgrade Available at level 3, this upgrade will make destroyed water drop Water Crystallized Essentia in 40% cases. With a 10% chance the essence will get poisoned due to magic pollution, otherwise known as flux, resulting in a Venenum aspect. Netheric Upgrade Available at level 3, this upgrade will allow the foci to destroy lava as well as water. Destroyed lava will also make all lava near the destroyed one to stop flowing. Just as water the lava will start flowing again after some time. Foci will still be able to destroy water. Destroying lava costs additional 3 Ignis essentia. Frugal upgrades will affect the ignis cost too. Its rank-5 upgrades are spell parts of their own, learnt with this research.
research.thaumaturgicbases.focus_experie: One can never have enough experience

The only ways of enchanting for a regular thaumaturge is either by using his own life essence to roll the dices or by using the infusion matrix to control the process. Either way some life essence is required. The most efficient way of collecting it is by... killing mobs? Mining? You think, that thaumaturgy must offer something else, more 'magical'. And this is it. This foci will instantly break the block it is used on, providing a thaumaturge with twice the experience the block would usually drop! Blocks, which usually do not provide experience will drop some based on the Potency level of the foci. Decomposing Upgrade Available at levels 3 and 5, this upgrade will allow a thaumaturge to instantly decompose any living entity into experience, based on the creature's current HP. The aspect cost is also based on the creature's HP. Note, that the absorbed creature will still drop the regular drops and experience. Level II decreases the cost for consuming creatures to half. Conflicts with the Vaporizing upgrade! Vaporizing Upgrade Available at levels 3 and 5, this upgrade will make consumed blocks also drop some Crystallized Essentia based on the block's aspects. Drop chance is 50%. Some very essentia-rich blocks will not drop it. Level II increases the chance of obtaining a Crystallized Essentia to 100% Conflicts with the Decomposing upgrade! Its rank-5 upgrades are spell parts of their own, learnt with this research.
research.thaumaturgicbases.focus_flux.st: Flux scrubbers are good, but they need to be more... controlled. You wonder if you can stick one on top of your wand... Well, it is not that simple, but definitely possible! This foci will remove the flux blocks a thaumaturge is looking at. yes, it is as simple as that. Warping Upgrade Available at level 3, this upgrade will warp the mind of the user of the foci, therefore adding some temporary warp every time a flux block is removed. Conflicts with the Crystallization upgrade! Calming Upgrade Available at level 5 if the Warping upgrade is present, this upgrade negates the effect of the Warping upgrade. It will calm the mind of the user of the foci, therefore removing some temporary warp, and some regular warp on occasion every time a flux block is removed. Conflicts with the Crystallization upgrade! Crystallization Upgrade Available at levels 3 and 5, this upgrade will make consumed flux blocks also drop some Potentia Crystallized Essentia. Level II flux blocks will drop a Random Crystallized Essentia instead of Potentia Crystallized Essentia Conflicts with the Warping and the Calming upgrade! Its rank-5 upgrades are spell parts of their own, learnt with this research.
research.thaumaturgicbases.glieonia.stag: How do you even pronounce that?
Nitor needs glowstone. A flower steeped in Lux, Praecantatio and Victus grows into Glieonia, which gives 2 glowstone dust when fully grown. Oddly, it gives off no light at all.
research.thaumaturgicbases.golden_oak.st: Gnawing at the bark of knowledge.

Trees resist the crucible, but infusion is strong enough. The Golden Oak Sapling grows like an oak, but any apple its leaves drop is a golden one. Greedy as it is, it keeps its saplings to itself, dropping fewer than an oak, and its leaves only come off whole with Silk Touch.
research.thaumaturgicbases.herobrines_sc: No one knows who forged this scythe. Each monster it strikes arcs lightning to the next one nearby, and the next, until none is left in reach. Its wielder moves half again as fast. The research only tells of it: like in Thaumic Bases, it cannot be crafted.
research.thaumaturgicbases.iron_spike.st: Sharp iron on a pressure plate makes a cruel trap: anything that walks into it, even a dropped item, takes 8 damage. A spike that kills turns bloody. Wipe a bloody spike with enchanted fabric to clean it and keep the bloody cloth; the crucible can wash the cloth back into fabric.
research.thaumaturgicbases.knose.stage_0: A forgotten plant from a lost world...
research.thaumaturgicbases.knose.stage_1: Plants have a memory of sorts. Infusing a rose with a great deal of Cognitio leaves it too weak for plain soil, but a crystal block makes a fine bed: the Rosa Mysteria soaks up the block's aspects while it grows. Once grown it yields a fragment attuned to that block. Using the fragment teaches you about the matching field of study; a balanced block gives a Mixed Fragment that touches every field. You suspect nothing good comes from a tainted block. A fragment can also be washed out in the crucible into an ordinary curio, losing much in the process.
research.thaumaturgicbases.knose.title: Rosa Mysteria
research.thaumaturgicbases.lazullia.stag: Why spend hours in caves looking for that blue ore? Lazullia grows slowly on farmland and, once ripe, gives lapis lazuli along with its seed.
research.thaumaturgicbases.lucrite.stage: A golden carrot infused with Desiderium grows into Lucrite. It is much like Metalleat but takes twice as long and depends on magic beneath it: it only grows on farmland laid over a block of Salis Mundus. Bone meal helps only one stage at a time. A ripe crop gives 3 gold nuggets, and now and then a golden carrot.
research.thaumaturgicbases.lucrite.title: Lucrite
research.thaumaturgicbases.magic_touch.s: Kills with this weapon shake loose aspect orbs of the victim's primal aspects; higher levels shake loose more.
research.thaumaturgicbases.master_entrop: After more work on entropy manipulation you have mastered it: with a dash of Fabrico you now get the full material back from wool and sand, and twice as much from blaze rods.
research.thaumaturgicbases.metalleat.sta: Iron is good for your health.

Wheat seeds infused with Metallum, kept alive with Victus and held in shape with Ordo, grow exactly like wheat but turn tough and metallic in their last stages. A ripe crop gives 2 iron nuggets. The same does not work with thaumium.
research.thaumaturgicbases.nether_saplin: This tree opens tiny unseen portals beneath its leaves, strong enough to turn the ground below into netherrack, soul sand and quartz ore, and now and then nether creatures slip through. Its wood and leaves are like netherrack: they never catch fire, but once lit they burn forever. It also takes root on nether blocks.
research.thaumaturgicbases.node_focus_br: Brightness foci will make the Manipulator extremely slowly turn the node into a Bright Node. Will only work with normal nodes. Takes 20 minutes to finish.
research.thaumaturgicbases.node_focus_de: Destruction foci will slowly destroy the node it is attached to. It will turn bright nodes into normal, normal into pales, pales into fading and will completely destroy fading nodes. On the other hand Vis from the node being destroyed will escape into surroundings in the form of Aspect Orbs, which can be absorbed by any wand. Vis escapes much faster than regulary.
research.thaumaturgicbases.node_focus_ef: Efficiency foci will affect the node in a very spectacular way. If any aspect is drained from the node affected with this foci there is a 50% chance that the aspect will be used, but will not be drained. Works with everything - wands, recharge pedestals, different constructs...
research.thaumaturgicbases.node_focus_hu: It is pretty obvious what this foci does

Hunger foci will make the Manipulator slowly turn the node into a Hungry Node. Will only work with normal nodes. Note, that the manipulator can freely be eaten by the hunger node, if it chooses to do so. Takes 5 minutes to finish. Authors are in no way responsible for the possible damage done to you, your house, your world, other worlds, your pets, animals, monsters, nodes and items. By crafting the foci you agree to being fully responsible to anything, that may happen with the foci, manipulator, node and everything surrounding the node.
research.thaumaturgicbases.node_focus_in: Instability foci will make the Manipulator slowly turn the node into an Unstable Node. Will only work with normal nodes. Takes 7 minutes to finish.
research.thaumaturgicbases.node_focus_pu: Purity foci will make the Manipulator slowly turn a Tainted node into normal and a normal node into Pure Node. Will only work with normal or tainted nodes. Takes 3 minutes to finish with a normal node or 33 minutes with a tainted node. Note that the node will not receive aspects that pure nodes usually have in them, but will still turn the biome around to Magical Forest.
research.thaumaturgicbases.node_focus_si: Sinister foci will make the Manipulator slowly turn the node into a Sinister Node. Removing the Pure modifier takes 30 minutes. Takes 6 minutes to turn a normal node into Sinister.
research.thaumaturgicbases.node_focus_sp: Restoration is a key to success

Speed foci increases the speed at which node restores it's aspects 5 times. It may be hard for a thaumaturge to see this in action, but should he use his wand, or any of his vis using devices it will become obvious.
research.thaumaturgicbases.node_focus_st: Stability foci will make the Manipulator slowly restore nodes. It will convert nodes into different types, using time. Converting a Fading node into Pale takes 5 minutes. Converting a Pale node into normal takes 10 minutes. Removing the Sinister modifier takes 2 minutes. Removing the Unstable modifier takes 7 minutes. Removing the Hunger modifier takes 30 seconds. Removing the Taint modifier takes 30 minutes.
research.thaumaturgicbases.node_focus_ta: Taint foci will make the Manipulator slowly turn the node into a tainted node. Will only work with normal nodes. Takes 6 minutes to finish. Note that the node will not receive aspects that tainted nodes usually have in them, but will still turn the biome around to tainted Lands.
research.thaumaturgicbases.node_linker.s: Nodes. The things that link your world to the world of magic. They are heavily used in thaumaturgy - some devices use them to function, you need them to recharge your wands. However there is a small problem - a node can always store that much of vis and if it has, for example, no terra it it - this is it, it has no terra, and that aspect can't be gained from the node. There sure is a so called 'node bullying' - one node eating other, smaller nodes. With the discovery of the Advanced node stabiliser that can be worked with, but it takes a ridiculous amount of time and also is unreliable. You have discovered a device that might get the job done. The node Linking Device creates a mysterious link between 2 nodes and will move aspects from the linked one to the linker. You need 2 of this devices placed on top of nodes. Then just take your wand and right click on the receiver. After that click on the transmitter - and the link will be established. The link will firstly drain all aspects out of the transmitting node's pull, then it will draw the node's capacity and will increase the receiver’s capacity based on that. Lastly the node without any capacity left will fade away. The chance of the receiver node to increase it's aspect capacity is around 70% for each capacity decrease on the transmitting node. The transmission however is pretty unstable - both nodes will react to the link. This will result in a so called instability. The more time the device functions - the more instability it will have. Based on the amount of instability different things may happen - from the aspects escaping out of nodes on both ends into air in form of flux, to the complete transmitting node destruction with the explosion. The receiving node however will never get harmed in any way. If you would only have a magic inert metal, forged from both, Nether and End, that could stabilize the link. In theory a Block of this supreme metal above this device would be sufficient. Right-click the receiving linker with a caster, then the transmitting one. Any block in the tag thaumaturgicbases:node_linker_stabilizers (Thaumic Tinkerer's ichorium block, when present) on top of the receiver stabilises the link.
research.thaumaturgicbases.node_manipula: You have discovered a way to support nodes by using stabilisers. You have discovered a way to tear the node apart, opening a small rift to wherever. Is this it for the nodes? It seems unfair, there are so many types of them - tainted, pure, hungry, they can be bright or fading... But all thaumaturges stop here, without attempting to go further. You can manipulate the very fabrics of the node, making it stable. You can tear it apart, energising it. Why not use those powers in combination to change the smallest fibres of the node? Why not study this? Is there something, that stops everyone from going this way, or are they just too blind, thinking they are the masters of thaumaturgy? Well, so far nothing really happened. Nothing came to stop you. Nothing killed you, nothing corrupted your mind - nothing! You do not understand the others not going this way. You have discovered a way to create the device that will combine the power of the Stabiliser to make the node stand and the ability of the Transducer to move node fibres, tearing it apart. Well, it is not that simple - you also need to constantly move Vis back and forth - some mirrors are required, and some flux formes, which is critical, so Flux scrubbers must be used too. And, for this construction to be stable some Salis Mundus is alse required. And here it is - the device, that can manipulate the node itself! It is not really that simple, actually. Your device can only work with regular nodes, energised are too powerful to work with. It also can only operate with the node from the top due to Vis flowing downwards, so it is impossible to have both the transducer and this device. It also turned out very... mundane. It is unable to operate with the node at all, as you though it would. It has the ability to do so, but the fibres of the node are not that simple to move - a Foci is required, and you do not know how to make one. You've tried regular wand foci - not much luck, just a bunch of angry wisps. However, the foci must work the same way - harnessing the raw power of the device to work with the node. The device itself is pretty stable, and, in fact, it does not require anything to work, which is comical due to the power of the device. The foci, should you obtain one must be simply placed in the bottom of the device, harnessing the raw power. Just click the device with the foci to put it in. Click with an empty hand to remove the foci. Click with another foci to swap between to - it is even possible to actually save the progress that way! It may require more or less time based on the action it is doing too! Right-click the manipulator with a focus to put it in, with an empty hand to take it out.
research.thaumaturgicbases.ore_destructi: Your mastery of Perditio lets you process crystal clusters, once mined whole, into loose vis crystals. Perditio alone is not enough: the crystals simply break unless Praecantatio fortifies them, and the cluster's own primal is needed too, or the crystals boil away at once. Each cluster gives four crystals. This is the best you can do with entropy... for now.
research.thaumaturgicbases.overchanter.s: Enchanting always seems to stop at some limit. The Overchanting Table pushes one level past it: it raises the first enchantment on an item by one, even beyond the usual maximum, so Fortune IV or Sharpness VI become possible. An enchantment it has raised once is skipped from then on. Set the item on the table and touch it with your caster, or give it a redstone signal. It draws 8 Praecantatio a second from jars within 8 blocks, 32 in all, and halfway through it takes 30 levels of experience: from experience tanks within 8 blocks first, else from a player within 6 blocks who has 30 levels, at the cost of a painful jolt. Taking the item off early wastes what was spent. Hoppers can feed it enchanted items and take back only finished ones.
research.thaumaturgicbases.peaceful_sapl: Animals gather where it is warm and bright. This tree makes those conditions beneath its leaves: the local biome's animals keep appearing under it, until a dozen creatures crowd the spot.
research.thaumaturgicbases.plax.stage_1: Sometimes a thaumaturge just needs string, and does not want to fight spiders for endless nights. Wheat seeds steeped with Fabrico grow into Plax, a crop that grows on farmland in 8 stages like wheat and gives 3 string when ripe. Right-click a ripe crop to pick it and leave it to regrow.
research.thaumaturgicbases.plax.title: Plax
research.thaumaturgicbases.pyrofluid.sta: Sometimes a thaumaturge just wants blaze powder without braving the Nether. A bucket of lava infused with Ignis and Praecantatio becomes Incendium, a liquid that has lost the ability to spread. Poured out, it slowly crystallises; once fully solid it can be broken by hand and gives a good handful of blaze powder. Until then it is every bit as dangerous as lava, so do not swim in it.
research.thaumaturgicbases.quicksilver.s: Every time you split silverwood into planks you wondered what the faint vapours were. They are quicksilver! Trapped in the crucible, Ordo crystallises them, though the silverwood quicksilver will not set until a little Mortuus is added too. One log gives three drops.
research.thaumaturgicbases.rainbow_cactu: Grow the rainbow, taste the rainbow!

A cactus soaked in Permutatio and Sensus grows like any cactus but no longer pricks. Break any part above the base and it scatters three to seven dyes of every colour, green most often; the base itself drops the cactus back.
research.thaumaturgicbases.redlon.stage_: Redstone is half magic already. Melon seeds charged with Machina and Potentia grow a stem that slowly sets a Block of Redstone beside itself, like a melon, only much more slowly.
research.thaumaturgicbases.redlon.title: Redlon
research.thaumaturgicbases.relocator.sta: Why can an arcane levitator not hang on a wall? A sturdier build can face any way it is placed, and it pushes whatever stands in front of it along its face: 10 blocks of reach for every relocator stacked behind it. Made with alumentum instead of nitor it pulls instead. Sneaking reverses the pull or push for you, a redstone signal switches it off, and a touch of your caster turns it to face the side you touched (sneaking: the opposite side).
research.thaumaturgicbases.revolver.stag: Thaumic weapons are good. Especially those where you do not have to get close to your enemies. Thaumaturgy however does not seem to offer much of those. Sure, there is a bow of bone, but... it is a bow. Even though it is enhanced with magic it still requires the wielder to pull the string. One might say - there are wand foci! Sure there are, and they are all great... But are they really weapons? They are put on top of wands and they use the energy of the wand. Well what if the Thaumaturge prefers his sceptres over wands? He... needs to craft another wand, just for those foci? Really? Some foci are also known for not working under certain conditions... Better to say in certain places... You have been engineering for a while now - this is what you have came with. A pretty strange contraption that is not all that big and is comfort to hold in hand. You have named your contraption "The Revolver". No, you have no idea why. The device is able to shoot very small yet extremely fast projectiles which deal devastating damage to anything they come in contact with. Due to your weapon having a magical nature those projectiles are also magical - they are created out of raw Telum essentia, stored in a jar inside of the revolver. One point of aspect is enough for just two shots. To open the revolver sneak and left-click anywhere. Sneaking also allows you to aim more precise. Right-click to shoot of course, that should be obvious. Load it by sneak-using it on a jar (or any essentia container) holding Aversio: one point fills two shots. Each upgrade has its own research and is infused onto the revolver one level at a time; upgrades that share a slot (the damage, barrel and round upgrades) replace one another only by starting again from a fresh revolver.
research.thaumaturgicbases.revolver_accu: You have found a way to give your revolver more sniping potential. With this upgrade your eyes will become more focused on the target while you are aiming, allowing you to aim more precise. Max Level: 3 Conflicts with: Speed, Efficiency Up to level 3; each level is infused onto the revolver in turn. TB's Accuracy did nothing in TB's own code; it is kept as an upgrade for its slot.
research.thaumaturgicbases.revolver_bane: You have found a way to improve your revolver against spiders and silverfish. This upgrade will make the revolver much more effective against those creatures, and will not affect the effectiveness against others. Max Level: 5 Conflicts with: Power, Silver, Bane Of Eldritch, Dueling, Eldritch Up to level 5; each level is infused onto the revolver in turn.

You have found a way to improve your revolver against eldritch creatures. This upgrade will make the revolver much more effective against those creatures, and will not affect the effectiveness against others. Max Level: 5 Conflicts with: Power, Silver, Bane Of Atropods, Dueling, Eldritch Up to level 5; each level is infused onto the revolver in turn.
research.thaumaturgicbases.revolver_duel: Sometimes the simple words are not enough, and a Thaumaurge needs to physically prove himself. Prior to the revolver discovery that could only be done via mundane swords and bows. Now a Thaumaturge and his offender can resolve their issue like two gentlemen - with their guns! This upgrade will make the revolver much more potent against other players, and will not affect the effectiveness against others. Max Level: 5 Conflicts with: Power, Silver, Bane Of Atropods, Bane Of Eldritch, Eldritch Up to level 5; each level is infused onto the revolver in turn.
research.thaumaturgicbases.revolver_effi: You have found a way to decrease the Telum consumption of the revolver. Each level of this upgrade will decrease the consumption by 1 unit of essentia. Max Level: 5 Conflicts with: Speed, Accuracy Up to level 5; each level is infused onto the revolver in turn.
research.thaumaturgicbases.revolver_eldr: Imbuing the revolver with the energy of the eldritch certainly does something... You have discovered what exactly. This upgrade will make the revolver much more potent against very strong creatures, aka bosses, but will decrease the effectiveness against others. Max Level: 2 Conflicts with: Power, Silver, Bane Of Atropods, Bane Of Eldritch, Dueling Up to level 2; each level is infused onto the revolver in turn.
research.thaumaturgicbases.revolver_heav: Sometimes a thaumaturge is just out of essentia that the revolver uses... But everything is not lost, the revolver itself is a decent melee weapon! Sure there can be an improvement... Each level of this upgrade will increase the damage the revolver does in melee by 2. Max Level: 5 Conflicts with: None Up to level 5; each level is infused onto the revolver in turn.
research.thaumaturgicbases.revolver_know: You have found a way to bind the bullets to your mind. The result is interesting - every slain creature might give you a sudden inspiration, or simply a knowledge point. No risk of warping your mind exists. Max Level: 5 Conflicts with: Primal, Tainted Up to level 5; each level is infused onto the revolver in turn.
research.thaumaturgicbases.revolver_pier: You have found a way to make your revolver much more devastating. This upgrade will make the bullets pierce through anyone they strike, dealing more damage than usual and continuing on travelling forward. Max Level: 1 Conflicts with: None Up to level 1; each level is infused onto the revolver in turn.
research.thaumaturgicbases.revolver_powe: More gunpowder to the damn thing!

You have discovered a way to improve the potency of your revolver. This upgrade will increase the damage the revolver does to any creature. No exceptions. However the damage increase is worse, than with the creature-specific upgrades. Max Level: 5 Conflicts with: Eldritch, Silver, Bane Of Atropods, Bane Of Eldritch, Dueling Up to level 5; each level is infused onto the revolver in turn.
research.thaumaturgicbases.revolver_prim: The primal energies pulse... What if you would imbue the revolver with them? The results are... interesting. Your revolver seems to have become a 'hit-scan' rather than 'shoot' type of weapon - it means that the bullets travel to their targets instantly. The bullets have also gained the ability to pierce walls. They also are much more dangerous now. However the cost for using the revolver is also now much higher - 2 essentia per shot! Max Level: 1 Conflicts with: Knowledge, Tainted Up to level 1; each level is infused onto the revolver in turn.
research.thaumaturgicbases.revolver_silv: You have discovered a way to improve the potency of your weapon against unholy creatures. This upgrade will make the revolver much more potent against undead creatures, demons and werewolves, and will not decrease the effectiveness against others. Max Level: 5 Conflicts with: Power, Eldritch, Bane Of Atropods, Bane Of Eldritch, Dueling Up to level 5; each level is infused onto the revolver in turn. Silver counts against undead, anything in thaumaturgicbases:revolver_demons (Neo Vitae's demons when it is installed) and Witchery's werewolves. Any silver ingot (#c:ingots/silver) or, as TB's fallback, a primal charm fills the middle slot.
research.thaumaturgicbases.revolver_spee: You have found a way to increase the speed at which your bullets travel. Each level of this upgrade will increase the speed of the bullets by... some amount, how can you tell? You clearly do not have any device or whatever to measure such fast movement!. Max Level: 5 Conflicts with: Efficiency, Accuracy Up to level 5; each level is infused onto the revolver in turn.
research.thaumaturgicbases.revolver_tain: Imbuing your weapon with taint might not be that good of an idea, but you've tried anyways. Anyway, here are the results - this upgrade will increase the raw damage of the revolver against every creature, except for the tainted ones - for them the damage will be decreased! The bullets also will have a chance to inflict the victim with Taint Poison! Max Level: 3 Conflicts with: Primal, Knowledge Up to level 3; each level is infused onto the revolver in turn.
research.thaumaturgicbases.revolver_void: Infusing the revolver with some void metal gives the gun the primal ability of the void metal - self-repairing. Warning - seeing the gun metal changing shape due to the void metal might not be a pleasant experience and may cause hallucinations and nightmares! Max Level: 3 Conflicts with: None Up to level 3; each level is infused onto the revolver in turn. A Void revolver also carries one warp a level while you hold it.
For a long time thaumaturges never thought of making a wand rod from thaumium itself.

Thaumium on its own is far too inert to carry vis, but Salis Mundus worked between the ingots solves that. The rod holds up to 80 of each primal and slowly recharges every primal by itself. You might see a spark or two crawl over its surface, but that is just your imagination, is it not?
research.thaumaturgicbases.rod_void.stag: After your journey into the abyssal depths you can make a very strange metal. What if a wand rod were made of it? Infused around a thaumium rod with void metal, blocks of Salis Mundus and tainted crystal blocks to make it taint-proof, the result pulses with power: it holds 160 of each primal and slowly gathers every primal by itself. This may be the most power you can get without venturing into the darkness once more.
Salis Mundus holds every primal aspect. Give the crucible all six primals and let a pinch of salis sit in it, and it soaks them up. On its own the salt is too fragile and boils away, but with some Praecantatio in the brew it holds together, and a moment later you are holding two piles.
research.thaumaturgicbases.salis_mundus_: Salis Mundus is a loose dust, so packing it into a block takes a little vis at the arcane workbench to fortify it. You are not yet sure what the block is good for besides steadying an infusion, but you will find more uses.
research.thaumaturgicbases.silverwood_pi: Greatwood pipes leave a taint in the smoke. Silverwood purifies it: tobacco smoked in a silverwood pipe is kinder, and some kinds do more. Plain tobacco eases warp more often, Angry tobacco may toughen you, Miner's tobacco may let you see in the dark, and the darker kinds lose their warp.
research.thaumaturgicbases.simple_duplic: You have mastered a little alchemical duplication. Arrows were the idea and arrows worked, with a touch of Aversio. Snowballs double with Gelum and, strangely enough, redstone with Machina and Potentia.
research.thaumaturgicbases.strong_entrop: You can apply extreme entropy to some items in the crucible, breaking them back into their components: glass and gravel crumble into sand, iron bars into nuggets. Perfect efficiency is out of reach here.
research.thaumaturgicbases.tainted.stage: Taint on a blade: +3 damage a level against anything not tainted itself, and its hits may infect the victim with flux taint. The enchanting table will not grant it; a sword left to despawn inside a tainted node may come back with it.
research.thaumaturgicbases.tainted.title: Tainted
research.thaumaturgicbases.thaumic_anvil: Why haven't they thought about this?

Mundane anvils crack after a few uses and refuse work past 40 levels. A thaumium anvil wears three times slower and takes on work up to 60 levels. Like every anvil of the craft it also steadies an infusion placed near the altar.
research.thaumaturgicbases.thaumic_spike: Thaumium spikes hit for 14, leave dropped items alone, and a redstone signal retracts them.
research.thaumaturgicbases.thauminite.st: Better metallurgy. A thaumaturge always searches for a better alternative to his materials, and thaumium has served for a while now. Maybe it is time to improve on it.

Thaumium can be processed further in the crucible with more Metallum, Praecantatio and plenty of Vitreus. The process destroys some of the metal, so one thaumium ingot only gives eight nuggets of the result. The new metal, thauminite, is almost as hard as diamond, far more magical than thaumium and takes enchantments much better. Tools made from it are nearly as durable as diamond ones, and every piece of thauminite armour lowers the vis cost of your wands, the helmet most of all.
research.thaumaturgicbases.tobacco.stage: Thaumaturges have long smoked dried herbs to clear the mind. Tobacco seeds come from wheat seeds in the crucible; the crop grows on farmland like wheat and gives its leaves when ripe. Ground in a mortar and pestle (it wears a little each time), the leaves become plain tobacco. Hold use with a pipe to smoke the first tobacco in your pack: plain tobacco now and then eases temporary warp. Mixed with essentia, plain tobacco becomes stronger kinds, each with its own effect.
research.thaumaturgicbases.tobacco.title: Tobacco
research.thaumaturgicbases.tobacco_eldri: Smoked, this blend opens your eyes to the Outer Lands: the death gaze withers what you look at for a while. In a greatwood pipe it also costs 3 temporary warp.
research.thaumaturgicbases.tobacco_fight: Gives Strength II for almost seven minutes; in a silverwood pipe sometimes Resistance as well.
research.thaumaturgicbases.tobacco_hunge: Fills you up like a meal; a greatwood pipe may leave you dizzy.
research.thaumaturgicbases.tobacco_knowl: Smoking it brings sudden insight: three observations in random fields, six in a silverwood pipe. In a greatwood pipe an eldritch insight also brings a little warp.
research.thaumaturgicbases.tobacco_minin: Gives Haste II for almost seven minutes; in a silverwood pipe sometimes Night Vision as well.
research.thaumaturgicbases.tobacco_sanit: Calms the mind: it often eases temporary warp, and in a silverwood pipe sometimes even lasting warp.
research.thaumaturgicbases.tobacco_taint: Why would anyone smoke this? 1-3 temporary warp, and sometimes lasting warp too. A silverwood pipe refuses it and shatters.
research.thaumaturgicbases.tobacco_wispy: The smoke of this blend gathers into a wisp of a random aspect. A silverwood pipe never makes a tainted one.
research.thaumaturgicbases.vaporising.st: Now and then a victim of this weapon crystallises: its aspects fall as vis crystals.
research.thaumaturgicbases.void_anvil.st: Void metal mends itself, and so does an anvil made of it: its wear slowly closes up on its own. It works differently, too: any operation, a simple rename or the merging of two great books, costs the same 3 levels and never wears it. Watching it repair tools, you notice void metal creeping into their cracks. Surely nothing to worry about.
research.thaumaturgicbases.void_seed.sta: Void seeds are over-infused and can no longer grow. Infusing one with every kind of plant life brings the seed back to life: plant it on farmland and it slowly grows void seeds of its own.
research.thaumaturgicbases.void_spike.st: Void metal spikes hit for 20 and strike as if a player had, so creatures slain on them drop what they would for you, experience included. Redstone retracts them, and void metal boots walk over them unharmed.
research.thaumaturgicbases.void_tools.st: Void metal makes fine shears and a flint and steel that, like all void metal gear, mend themselves in your pack, at the price of a little warp while carried.
spell.thaumaturgicbases.activation.desc: Sneak-cast at a block to remember it; cast again to use it from afar.
spell.thaumaturgicbases.activation.name: Activation
spell.thaumaturgicbases.aquatic.desc: Water may be crystallised into essentia upon draining
spell.thaumaturgicbases.aquatic.name: Liquid Drain: Aquatic
spell.thaumaturgicbases.calming.desc: Negates the Warping effect. Removed flux blocks can remove temporary and regular warp from the remover
spell.thaumaturgicbases.calming.name: Flux Scrubber: Calming
spell.thaumaturgicbases.crystalization.d: Flux blocks can drop Potentia essence. On level II drops random essence
spell.thaumaturgicbases.crystalization_g: Removed flux blocks may drop the crystal of any aspect.
spell.thaumaturgicbases.decomposing.desc: Allows Experience Foci to absorb mobs for experience.
spell.thaumaturgicbases.decomposing.name: Experience: Decomposing
spell.thaumaturgicbases.drain.desc: Removes the water sources you look at while held.
spell.thaumaturgicbases.drain.name: Liquid Drain
spell.thaumaturgicbases.experience.desc: Consumes the block you look at and turns it into experience.
spell.thaumaturgicbases.experience.name: Experience
spell.thaumaturgicbases.flux_scrub.desc: Removes the flux goo and gas around the point you look at while held.
spell.thaumaturgicbases.flux_scrub.name: Flux Scrubber
spell.thaumaturgicbases.netheric.desc: Allows the Drain Foci to work on Lava blocks.
spell.thaumaturgicbases.netheric.name: Liquid Drain: Netheric
spell.thaumaturgicbases.vaporizing.desc: Experience Foci can create crystallised essentia from absorbed blocks.
spell.thaumaturgicbases.vaporizing.name: Experience: Vaporizing
spell.thaumaturgicbases.warping.desc: Removing flux blocks will inflict warp on the remover
spell.thaumaturgicbases.warping.name: Flux Scrubber: Warping
tb.txt.wrongDimension: The link is in another dimension
